FAQs

Isn't this just another design subscription?

No. Penji gives you a full roster of specialists across 120+ design categories, AI-enhanced workflows, and a platform built to manage it all — without juggling freelancers or learning new AI tools.

How much creative direction do I get on each plan?

Essentials is self-managed — there's no Art Director, so you write the briefs and drive the work while our QA and PMs keep quality in check. Agency Partner adds an Art Director who oversees your work and plans with you on monthly strategy calls. Dedicated Team gives you a Senior Art Director who leads the work proactively across a dedicated creative pod. If you know exactly what you want — Essentials. If you want someone steering it with you — Agency Partner or Dedicated Team.

Why not just use AI design tools?

AI tools still struggle with brand nuance and creative judgment. Penji is human-first, AI-enabled — real designers using AI to move faster, iterate smarter, and deliver work that actually looks like your brand.

How fast can I get started?

Under 5 minutes. Sign up, submit your first project immediately. An Account Executive will also schedule a quick onboarding call — don't skip it, it makes a real difference.

How fast will I get designs back?

Most projects deliver in 1 business day. Complex work like motion graphics or multi-page decks may take longer. When one project finishes, the next in your queue starts the same day.

How does the "2 concurrent projects" work?

You can queue as many projects as you want — no limits. We actively work on 2 at a time. Finished one? The next starts immediately. It's an always-moving production line, not a one-at-a-time ticket system.

Will I get the same designer every time?

Not guaranteed, but you can request a favorite through your Project Manager and we'll assign them as often as possible. For a fully dedicated, locked-in designer — that's Dedicated Team.

How do revisions work?

Inside the Penji platform, you can point, highlight, and annotate directly on your design. All notes are organized for your designer in one place, tracked, and marked complete when addressed. No email threads. No lost screenshots.

Where are your designers located?

Across 20+ countries in Asia, Europe, Australia, and the Americas. All full-time Penji employees — not freelancers or gig workers.

Is there a money-back guarantee?

Yes. Full refund within 30 days, no questions asked. We don't keep customers with contracts — we keep them with quality.

Can I cancel anytime?

Yes. No contracts, no cancellation fees. Cancel directly in the app or email us at [email protected].

How do I get help if I'm stuck?

Submit a support request directly inside the Penji app or email [email protected]. No phone support on Essentials.
